name: category-bubbles
title: CategoryBubbles
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: Category spend as a field of bubbles around a core figure. Use when showing where money went across categories.

hairline.purpose: Shows the share each category takes of a total, as area.
hairline.antiExampleWhy: With two categories the field is two circles and a lot of empty instrument furniture; a meter bar says the same thing in a tenth of the space.

docs: Share is encoded as area, so radius is the square root of share — do not scale radius linearly or large categories will dwarf the field. The rings and tick collar are furniture and never carry data.
